_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Elemental Exercise#000.src: I do have one. If our enemies are susceptible to the elements in this way, would that also apply to us?
Elemental Exercise#000.dst: 하나 있어요. 적이 이렇게 원소에 약하다면, 저희도 마찬가지인가요?

Elemental Exercise#001.src: Ah, yes. A fine observation. Indeed, you are also bound to the rules of the elements. Elemental defenses and weaknesses from your equipment will affect you in the very same way.
Elemental Exercise#001.dst: 아, 그렇지. 좋은 지적이야. 자네들도 원소의 법칙에 묶여 있네. 장비의 원소 방어와 약점도 똑같이 자네들에게 영향을 주지.

Elemental Exercise#002.src: However, you have another tool at your disposal in the form of your spells! Different spells will deal different elemental damage, even if your weapon does not use that element by default.
Elemental Exercise#002.dst: 하지만 자네들에겐 주문이라는 또 다른 도구가 있지! 무기가 기본으로 그 원소를 쓰지 않더라도, 주문마다 다른 원소 피해를 준다네.

Elemental Exercise#003.src: ...Oh! So my Bash spell will still deal  Earth damage even if my weapon only uses  Water , right?
Elemental Exercise#003.dst: ...아! 그럼 무기가  물 원소만 써도 Bash 주문은  대지 피해를 주는 거죠?

Elemental Exercise#004.src: Correct! Now, let's see... We have the two of you here. Why don't we have a friendly duel? A chance to test your battle skills in a safe environment.
Elemental Exercise#004.dst: 정답이야! 자, 보자... 여기 둘이 있으니 친선 결투를 해 보는 건 어떤가? 안전한 곳에서 실력을 시험할 기회지.

Elemental Exercise#005.src: The leader has been slain! Take out the stragglers, soldiers! The battle has been won!
Elemental Exercise#005.dst: 우두머리가 쓰러졌다! 남은 놈들을 처리하라, 병사들이여! 전투는 우리의 승리다!

Elemental Exercise#006.src: We've been seeing more attacks from {p} recently... good grief, when will that Graken do his job and sort it out?
Elemental Exercise#006.dst: 요즘 {p} 쪽에서 공격이 잦아졌어... 원 참, 그 Graken은 언제 제 할 일 해서 정리할 건가?

Elemental Exercise#007.src: Hmph. Well, regardless, the two of you fought well! The training seems to have paid off.
Elemental Exercise#007.dst: 흠. 뭐, 어쨌든 둘 다 잘 싸웠네! 훈련한 보람이 있군.

Elemental Exercise#008.src: Thank you, sir! That summoner was a tough foe, but it was nothing we couldn't handle... right, {u}?
Elemental Exercise#008.dst: 감사합니다, 대장님! 그 소환사는 까다로운 적이었지만 저희가 못 당할 정도는 아니었어요... 그렇지, {u}?

Elemental Exercise#009.src: Hm... Let us return to the barracks. I'll have to speak to the Admiral when he returns, and I'd like for the two of you to be present.
Elemental Exercise#009.dst: 흠... 병영으로 돌아가세. 제독님이 돌아오시면 말씀드려야 하는데, 자네 둘도 함께 있었으면 하네.

Elemental Exercise#010.src: He wants us to be there for a meeting with the Admiral...? Huh. What do you think that could be about?
Elemental Exercise#010.dst: 제독님과의 회의에 우리도 같이 있으래...? 흠. 무슨 일일 것 같아?

Elemental Exercise#011.src: ... Hopefully it's not anything bad. He did seem to approve of our combat prowess, but-... Nevermind. We should get going.
Elemental Exercise#011.dst: ... 나쁜 일이 아니면 좋겠다. 우리 전투 실력은 인정하시는 것 같았는데-... 아니야. 이제 가자.

Elemental Exercise#012.src: Ahem. Before you return to your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#012.dst: 에헴. 둘 다 돌아가기 전에 줄 게 있네. 오늘 일의 보수와 특별한 장비 하나야. 잘 쓰게.

Elemental Exercise#013.src: Talk to Captain Ragon in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#014.src: Ah! You must be one of the new recruits the Admiral told me to look out for! What was it... {u}, yes?
Elemental Exercise#014.dst: 아! 제독님이 눈여겨보라던 신병 중 하나로군! 이름이 뭐였더라... {u}, 맞나?
Elemental Exercise#014.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#015.src: You've done well to reach this city as quickly as you have, which must have required a great deal of fighting the undead.
Elemental Exercise#015.dst: 이렇게 빨리 이 도시에 오다니 잘했네. 오는 길에 언데드와 꽤 많이 싸웠겠지.
Elemental Exercise#015.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#016.src: Now, I've heard from Sergeant Van of your aid in his assault on our overtaken fort- which, good work, very well done...
Elemental Exercise#016.dst: Van 병장에게 들었네. 점령당한 요새 탈환을 도왔다지? 아주 훌륭했어...
Elemental Exercise#016.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#017.src: But the fact still stands that you lack experience. You can certainly fight, yes, but can you fight well?
Elemental Exercise#017.dst: 하지만 경험이 부족한 건 사실이지. 싸울 줄은 알겠지만, 잘 싸우나?
Elemental Exercise#017.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#018.src: Lucky for you, that's where I come in. You're just in time for today's training session! Come here, follow me.
Elemental Exercise#018.dst: 운이 좋군, 그래서 내가 있는 거지. 마침 오늘 훈련 시간이야! 이리 오게, 따라와.
Elemental Exercise#018.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#019.src: Follow Captain Ragon to the Training Room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#020.src: ...Oh! {u}, hello. Are you here for training as well?
Elemental Exercise#020.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#021.src: Ahem. Now, in front of you, you'll see five special training dummies. Each one finely imbued with elemental magic. You are aware of the elements, yes? There's five of them in total.
Elemental Exercise#021.dst: 에헴. 자, 앞에 특수 훈련용 허수아비 다섯 개가 보일 걸세. 각각 원소 마법이 정교하게 깃들어 있지. 원소는 알고 있겠지? 모두 다섯 가지야.
Elemental Exercise#021.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#022.src: I am! The elements are... Fire, Air, Earth, Thunder, and... Water?
Elemental Exercise#022.dst: 알아요! 원소는... 화염, 바람, 대지, 번개, 그리고... 물?
Elemental Exercise#022.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#023.src: That's right. And generally speaking, they're strong against each other in that order- Fire beats Air, Air beats Earth, and so on.
Elemental Exercise#023.dst: 맞네. 대체로 그 순서대로 서로에게 강하지. 화염은 바람을, 바람은 대지를 이기는 식으로.
Elemental Exercise#023.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#024.src: Elemental weaknesses may vary based on the enemy, but that order holds true in most cases.
Elemental Exercise#024.dst: 원소 약점은 적마다 다를 수 있지만, 대부분은 그 순서가 통하네.
Elemental Exercise#024.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#025.src: Enemies will take more damage from elements they're weak to, and take less damage from elements they resist. This change to your damage is always a flat value, and it varies from enemy to enemy.
Elemental Exercise#025.dst: 적은 약한 원소에 피해를 더 받고, 저항하는 원소에는 덜 받지. 이 피해 변화는 항상 고정값이고, 적마다 다르네.
Elemental Exercise#025.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#026.src: Now. For training purposes, you'll be given an elemental weapon to try out on these training dummies. Take note of how each elemental defense and weakness affects your damage dealt. Speak to me once you feel you understand the concept.
Elemental Exercise#026.dst: 자. 훈련을 위해 원소 무기를 줄 테니 이 허수아비들에게 써 보게. 원소별 방어와 약점이 주는 피해에 어떤 영향을 주는지 잘 보게나. 이해했다 싶으면 내게 말하게.
Elemental Exercise#026.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#027.src: Test out the elemental training weapons on the dummies, then speak to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#027.dst: 허수아비에게 원소 훈련 무기를 시험해 본 뒤 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Ragon 대장과 대화하세요.

Elemental Exercise#028.src: Well? Have you noted the effect of elemental defenses and weaknesses on your damage?
Elemental Exercise#028.dst: 어떤가? 원소 방어와 약점이 피해에 주는 영향을 확인했나?
Elemental Exercise#028.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#029.src: Excellent. I'll take those training weapons back from the two of you. Any questions?
Elemental Exercise#029.dst: 훌륭하군. 두 사람의 훈련 무기는 회수하겠네. 질문 있나?
Elemental Exercise#029.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#030.src: I do have one. If our enemies are susceptible to elements in this way, would that also apply to us?
Elemental Exercise#030.dst: 하나 있어요. 적이 이렇게 원소에 약하다면, 저희도 마찬가지인가요?
Elemental Exercise#030.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#031.src: Ah, yes. A fine observation. Indeed, you are also bound by the rules of the elements. Elemental defenses and weaknesses from your equipment will affect you in the very same way.
Elemental Exercise#031.dst: 아, 그렇지. 좋은 지적이야. 자네들도 원소의 법칙에 묶여 있네. 장비의 원소 방어와 약점도 똑같이 자네들에게 영향을 주지.
Elemental Exercise#031.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#032.src: One final note before we move on from the elements- your weapon may not always be as effective against an enemy as you would like.
Elemental Exercise#032.dst: 원소 이야기를 마치기 전에 마지막으로, 무기가 늘 원하는 만큼 적에게 효과적이진 않을 걸세.
Elemental Exercise#032.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#033.src: However, you have another tool at your disposal in the form of your spells! Different spells will deal different elemental damage, even if your weapon does use that element by default.
Elemental Exercise#033.dst: 하지만 자네들에겐 주문이라는 또 다른 도구가 있지! 무기가 기본으로 그 원소를 쓰지 않더라도, 주문마다 다른 원소 피해를 준다네.
Elemental Exercise#033.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#034.src: ...Oh! So my Bash spell will still deal Earth damage even if my weapon only uses Water, right?
Elemental Exercise#034.dst: ...아! 그럼 무기가 물 원소만 써도 Bash 주문은 대지 피해를 주는 거죠?
Elemental Exercise#034.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#035.src: Correct! Now, let's see... We have the two of you here. Why don't we have a friendly duel? A chance to test your battle skills in a save environment.
Elemental Exercise#035.dst: 정답이야! 자, 보자... 여기 둘이 있으니 친선 결투를 해 보는 건 어떤가? 안전한 곳에서 실력을 시험할 기회지.
Elemental Exercise#035.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#036.src: That sounds good to me! {u}, we've been traveling together for some time now... I can't say I haven't been curious to see how you fight. Let's see who comes out on top, shall we?
Elemental Exercise#036.dst: 좋아요! {u}, 우리 같이 여행한 지도 꽤 됐잖아... 네가 어떻게 싸우는지 솔직히 궁금했어. 누가 이기나 볼까?
Elemental Exercise#036.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#038.src: Alright. I'll be waiting here when you're ready!
Elemental Exercise#038.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#039.src: Go on, then. Just speak to me when you're ready to move on.
Elemental Exercise#039.dst: 그럼 가 보게. 다음으로 넘어갈 준비가 되면 말하게.
Elemental Exercise#039.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#040.src: Return to Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for a duel.

Elemental Exercise#041.src: There you are! Are you ready for our duel?
Elemental Exercise#041.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#042.src: Alright! Let's see which of us is the better fighter!
Elemental Exercise#042.dst: 좋아! 누가 더 잘 싸우는지 보자!
Elemental Exercise#042.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#044.src: Fight Tasim in a friendly duel.

Elemental Exercise#046.src: Phew! That was a good fight. You did well, {u}. We'll have to do this again- and maybe we can get Aledar to join!
Elemental Exercise#046.dst: 휴! 좋은 승부였어. 잘했어, {u}. 또 하자. Aledar도 끼워 줄 수 있을지 몰라!
Elemental Exercise#046.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#047.src: Woo! You fought well, {u}, but it looks like I'm still better! Wait until Aledar hears about this...
Elemental Exercise#047.dst: 와! 잘 싸웠어, {u}. 그래도 내가 아직 한 수 위인가 봐! Aledar가 들으면...
Elemental Exercise#047.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#048.src: Yes, yes, fine work, the two of you. Now-
Elemental Exercise#048.dst: 그래, 그래, 둘 다 잘했네. 자, 이제...
Elemental Exercise#048.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#049.src: Captain! Captain Ragon! There's- there's corrupted forces! Advancing from {p}!
Elemental Exercise#049.dst: 대장님! Ragon 대장님! 타, 타락한 병력이! {p} 쪽에서 진격해 옵니다!
Elemental Exercise#049.speaker: Scout Evelyn

Elemental Exercise#050.src: Hm. And the Admiral is away... Very well. Mobilize the troops! We meet the forces at the north gate!
Elemental Exercise#050.dst: 흠. 제독님도 안 계신데... 좋아. 병력을 소집하라! 북문에서 맞선다!
Elemental Exercise#050.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#052.src: Captain- we're capable fighters too. Let us come along and help fight off these undead!
Elemental Exercise#052.dst: 대장님, 저희도 싸울 수 있어요. 같이 가서 언데드를 물리치게 해 주세요!
Elemental Exercise#052.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#053.src: Hm... As I see it, this is a fine opportunity for you to gain some firsthand experience! Very well. Prepare yourselves, and come to {p}' north gate when you're ready.
Elemental Exercise#053.dst: 흠... 내가 보기엔 직접 경험을 쌓을 좋은 기회로군! 좋아. 준비하고, 다 되면 {p} 북문으로 오게.
Elemental Exercise#053.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#054.src: This is exciting! But... I'm a little bit nervous, still.
Elemental Exercise#054.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#055.src: ... We'll be alright. Come on, let's go follow the captain.
Elemental Exercise#055.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#056.src: Follow Captain Ragon to {p}' north gate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to face the undead forces.
Elemental Exercise#056.dst: Ragon 대장을 따라 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} 북문으로 가서 언데드 병력에 맞서세요.

Elemental Exercise#057.src: There you are! Ready for battle?
Elemental Exercise#057.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#058.src: I'm prepared as well. These corrupted won't stand a chance against us!
Elemental Exercise#058.dst: 저도 준비됐어요. 이 타락자들은 저희를 못 당해요!
Elemental Exercise#058.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#059.src: Yes, yes, very good. Now, it shouldn't be long until-
Elemental Exercise#059.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#061.src: Hm... Take note of the leader. I expect if we can defeat it, the rest of the forces will disperse.
Elemental Exercise#061.dst: 흠... 우두머리를 잘 보게. 저놈만 쓰러뜨리면 나머지 병력은 흩어질 걸세.
Elemental Exercise#061.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#062.src: Stronger foes such as this one will cast spells one after the other, in a specific order. These spell combos can be dangerous, so make sure to take note of them.
Elemental Exercise#062.dst: 이런 강한 적은 정해진 순서대로 주문을 연달아 쓰지. 이런 주문 연계는 위험할 수 있으니 꼭 잘 봐 두게.
Elemental Exercise#062.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#063.src: We'll be fighting all around you, so shout if you're in need of aid. Alright, soldiers, let's defend our city!
Elemental Exercise#063.dst: 우리가 사방에서 싸울 테니 도움이 필요하면 외치게. 좋아, 병사들이여, 도시를 지켜라!
Elemental Exercise#063.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#065.src: I understand. We have time until the corrupted forces arrive, so go prepare. Don't take too long, though.
Elemental Exercise#065.dst: 알겠네. 타락한 병력이 오기까지 시간이 있으니 준비하게. 너무 오래 걸리진 말고.
Elemental Exercise#065.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#066.src: Defeat the Corrupted Captain and the force threatening {p}.

Elemental Exercise#067.src: Return to the {p} Barracks and talk to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#068.src: Ah, there you two are. Come here.
Elemental Exercise#068.dst: 아, 둘 다 왔군. 이리 오게.
Elemental Exercise#068.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#070.src: Yes, my absence was never meant to take long. I was paying a visit to the desert city of {p}, for a meeting with an Admiral Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#070.dst: 그래, 오래 자리를 비울 생각은 없었지. 사막 도시 {p}에 가서 Amerigo 제독과 회담을 했네...
Elemental Exercise#070.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#071.src: But I digress. I've been told the two of you were essential in the defense of our city! Excellent work.
Elemental Exercise#071.dst: 얘기가 샜군. 도시 방어에 자네 둘이 큰 몫을 했다고 들었네! 훌륭해.
Elemental Exercise#071.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#072.src: Our preparations for the assault on {p}' spider den are nearing completion. I'd like the two of you to join that mission.
Elemental Exercise#072.dst: {p}의 거미 소굴 공격 준비가 거의 끝나 가네. 자네 둘도 그 임무에 합류했으면 하네.
Elemental Exercise#072.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#073.src: Sir- are you certain? I mean, we'd be happy to join, but surely there are many others more worthy of such a task.
Elemental Exercise#073.dst: 제독님, 정말이세요? 기꺼이 가겠지만, 그 임무엔 더 적합한 분들이 많을 텐데요.
Elemental Exercise#073.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#074.src: Nonsense! Captain Ragon has assessed your skills, and has deemed them sufficient. And I trust the Captain's judgement.
Elemental Exercise#074.dst: 무슨 소리! Ragon 대장이 자네들 실력을 평가해 충분하다고 판단했네. 난 대장의 판단을 믿지.
Elemental Exercise#074.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#075.src: Now, I must be off. I'll see the two of you when it's time for the mission.
Elemental Exercise#075.dst: 자, 난 가 봐야겠네. 임무 때가 되면 다시 보세.
Elemental Exercise#075.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#076.src: A big mission to take out the spiders, huh... You know, even though I'm a little worried, I think I'm excited.
Elemental Exercise#076.dst: 거미 소탕 대작전이라... 있잖아, 좀 걱정되긴 하지만 설레는 것 같아.
Elemental Exercise#076.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#077.src: Ahem. Before the two of you return on your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#077.dst: 에헴. 둘 다 돌아가기 전에 줄 게 있네. 오늘 일의 보수와 특별한 장비 하나야. 잘 쓰게.
Elemental Exercise#077.speaker: Captain Ragon
